title: Place every source file beneath its plan-declared feature directory

facts.note: source_root comes from the `topology:` settings in atdd-bun.yaml (default `src/wagons`). Applies to every source file there, whatever its language, and whether it is new, moved or unchanged. Paths under node_modules, dist, build and _generated are excluded.
Any source file beneath source_root. The source names no language filter.

values: plan models >=1 wagon, feature or WMBT
facts.note: Precondition: the plan under plan_root declares at least one wagon, feature or WMBT. Checking this needs a plan reader.

fires: The plan models at least one wagon, feature or WMBT, and any source file beneath <source_root> (new, moved or existing and unchanged) sits outside `<source_root>/<wagon>/features/<feature>/`.
The plan models at least one wagon, feature or WMBT, and a source file beneath <source_root> sits under a feature directory the plan does not declare.

The plan models at least one wagon, feature or WMBT (including a plan that models only WMBTs), and any in-scope source file has a missing or malformed `URN: component:...` header. The same validator reports this. The obligation belongs to split rule atdd-bun.topology.source-urn-header.
doesNotFire: Files in vendored or generated trees (node_modules, dist, build, _generated).
The plan does not yet model any wagon, feature or WMBT.

given: The plan models at least one wagon, feature or WMBT, and source files exist beneath <source_root> (the `topology.source_root` key in atdd-bun.yaml, default `src/wagons`), excluding vendored and generated trees.
when: Any source file beneath <source_root> is checked. This covers new, moved and existing unchanged files.
then: Each such file lives beneath `<source_root>/<wagon>/features/<feature>/` for a feature the plan declares.
prefer: Fix a finding by moving the file beneath its feature's directory and adding the component URN header.
Make the URN's wagon and feature segments match the directory the file lives in.
avoid: Source files under <source_root> placed outside any `<wagon>/features/<feature>/` directory.
Placing source under a feature directory the plan does not declare.

Leaving an in-scope source file without a well-formed `URN: component:{wagon}:{feature}:{name}:{frontend|backend}:{domain|application|integration|presentation}` header. The same validator fails on this, so treat it as required alongside placement. Its obligation is proposed as split rule atdd-bun.topology.source-urn-header.
unless: Vendored and generated trees (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`) are never scanned.
why: Source is traced to its owning feature by its URN and found by its path. If either is missing, nobody can show that the feature has an implementation.
evidence: The atdd_topology validator reports no finding for any file beneath <source_root>. Every file sits under `<source_root>/<wagon>/features/<feature>/` for a plan-declared feature and has a well-formed component URN.
verifier_detail: Precondition: the rule is active only when the plan models at least one wagon, feature or WMBT. It then checks every source file beneath source_root, not only changed files.
topology_settings: the `topology:` keys `plan_root`, `source_root`, `test_root` and `e2e_root` in `atdd-bun.yaml`. Defaults are `plan`, `src/wagons`, `tests/wagons` and `e2e`.
audit: package_rule: a rule of this package's own gates (`atdd-bun.*`). A package guard realizes it, not a canonical planner node. It gets the same per-rule checks as every convention: a convention, strict, a failing fixture and relationship edges.
Original name and summary: Feature source lives beneath its feature and carries a component URN.

Original statement: When the plan models at least one wagon, feature or WMBT, every source file beneath `<source_root>` carries `URN: component:{wagon}:{feature}:{name}:{frontend|backend}:{domain|application|integration|presentation}` and lives beneath `<source_root>/<wagon>/features/<feature>/`, for a feature the plan declares. Package rule, strict.

splitSuggestion.then: When the plan models at least one wagon, feature or WMBT (including WMBT-only plans), every source file beneath <source_root> (new, moved or unchanged; vendored and generated trees node_modules/dist/build/_generated excluded) carries a well-formed `URN: component:{wagon}:{feature}:{name}:{frontend|backend}:{domain|application|integration|presentation}` header. Why: source is traced to its owning feature by its URN. Strict, severity 3, validator atdd_topology. Fix: add the component URN header.

Remaining rule: when the plan models at least one wagon, feature or WMBT, every source file beneath <source_root> (vendored and generated trees excluded) lives beneath `<source_root>/<wagon>/features/<feature>/` for a feature the plan declares.

sharedNodes.text: Strict disposition: the rule fails on every finding. There is no advisory mode.

additions.text: The source statement holds two independently satisfiable obligations: a URN header and directory placement. `then` keeps placement, which matches the rule id. The URN-header obligation becomes the proposed rule atdd-bun.topology.source-urn-header. It keeps the same activation (WMBT-only plans included), exclusions, rationale, severity and validator, and is mirrored in avoid[2], fires[2] and evidence[0] until the split happens.
additions.justification: Rule 2 requires one obligation in `then`, and the auditor asked for the split.

additions.text: Make the URN's wagon and feature segments match the directory the file lives in.
additions.justification: The source says the URN and the path both identify the same plan-declared feature. This is stated as a preference, not a new obligation.

additions.text: The config key and default for <source_root> (`topology.source_root`, default `src/wagons`) are repeated in coder-facing text.
additions.justification: Reviewer flagged that coders could not resolve <source_root> without reading verifier_detail. This copies S012 content; it is not a new obligation.

trace.note: URN-header half is proposed as split rule atdd-bun.topology.source-urn-header
